findings.description: The plan must not promise no-turn real-time delivery after an external reap while detach and standalone supervisors remain forbidden.
findings.resolution: Plan now defines the enforceable bound as zero loss plus next session-bound event/re-arm initial-scan delivery, and calls out the no-turn wall-clock limitation.
findings.suggestedFix: State the boundary explicitly in Overview, Acceptance Criteria, and Open Questions.

findings.description: Identity-aware demotion could allow duplicate active listeners if true listener identity is classified too strictly.
findings.resolution: Plan now requires preserving same-listener redundant-arm skip tests and adding foreign/recycled PID demotion tests.
findings.suggestedFix: Pin both true-active and foreign/recycled branches in tests.

findings.description: Crews release surfaces must include version manifests, marketplaces, changelog, AGENTS notes, and version tests.
findings.resolution: Plan now includes a release-verification story and explicit version/changelog/AGENTS files.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a release story and acceptance criteria.
